metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Thailand between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Thermal Anomalies & Fire 1km Daily (Terra: MODIS/061/MOD14A1, Aqua: MODIS/061/MYD14A1) from 2016-08-01 to 2018-03-01; countries from USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017 for Cambodia and Thailand. 2. Masking: No cloud masking; count active fire detections where FireMask >= 7 (low, nominal, high confidence fires). Use 0/1 binary mask without selfMask to avoid null sums. 3. Valid Zero vs Null: Compute total pixel counts for each country to ensure region overlaps. If both collections empty -> C1. If pixel count 0 -> C2. If sums are None/NaN -> C3. Catch exceptions -> D. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions start = '2016-08-01' end = '2018-03-01' # exclusive end to include February 2018 countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') kh = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia')).geometry() th = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Thailand')).geometry() terra_id = 'MODIS/061/MOD14A1' aqua_id = 'MODIS/061/MYD14A1' def get_col(id_, geom): return ee.ImageCollection(id_).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom) def det_mask(img): # Binary 0/1: FireMask >= 7 considered an active fire detection return img.select('FireMask').gte(7).rename('det').toUint8() def compute_for_country(geom): colT = get_col(terra_id, geom) colA = get_col(aqua_id, geom) nT = colT.size().getInfo() nA = colA.size().getInfo() if (nT + nA) == 0: return {'status':'C1', 'nT':nT, 'nA':nA} # Base image for pixel count (ensure at least one image exists) base = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(nT > 0, colT.first(), colA.first())) # Count of valid pixels at 1 km over the country (sanity check) px = base.select('FireMask').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('FireMask').getInfo() if px is None or px == 0: return {'status':'C2', 'nT':nT, 'nA':nA, 'px':px} detT = colT.map(det_mask) detA = colA.map(det_mask) union = detT.merge(detA) sum_img = union.sum() det = sum_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('det').getInfo() # Validation if det is None: return {'status':'C3', 'nT':nT, 'nA':nA, 'px':px} try: det = float(det) except Exception: return {'status':'C3', 'nT':nT, 'nA':nA, 'px':px} if det < 0: return {'status':'C3', 'nT':nT, 'nA':nA, 'px':px} return {'status':'OK', 'nT':nT, 'nA':nA, 'px':int(px), 'det':int(round(det))} try: kh_res = compute_for_country(kh) th_res = compute_for_country(th) print(f"Date: {start} to {end}") # Handle error cases if kh_res.get('status') != 'OK' or th_res.get('status') != 'OK': # Prefer the earliest failure class among C1/C2/C3 statuses = [kh_res.get('status'), th_res.get('status')] if 'C1' in statuses: print("One or both countries: Empty Collection.") print("C1") elif 'C2' in statuses: print("One or both countries: No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") elif 'C3' in statuses: print("Calculation returned None/invalid.") print("C3") else: print("Processing error.") print("D") else: print(f"MOD14A1 imgs (KH,TH): {kh_res['nT']}, {th_res['nT']}") print(f"MYD14A1 imgs (KH,TH): {kh_res['nA']}, {th_res['nA']}") print(f"Valid pixels@1km (KH,TH): {kh_res['px']}, {th_res['px']}") print(f"Detections (pixel-days, KH): {kh_res['det']}") print(f"Detections (pixel-days, TH): {th_res['det']}") ans = 'A' if kh_res['det'] > th_res['det'] else 'B' print(ans) except Exception as e: # Any runtime or API error print("D") ```
